correctness.rationale: The normalized addition theorem reduces rank to the parity quotient M_l. The twelve antipodal root lines decompose by three orthogonal K4 components; independently W*W=3I proves S has eigenvalues 4 (4) and -2 (8). These identities yield the exact 1+2+9 and 4+8 Gram formulas. The Chebyshev recurrence gives finite exceptional ranks and strict lower bounds for all higher degrees. A standalone exact-integer checker verifies the defining relations and formulas through degree 47; the infinite range is proved analytically.

value.rationale: A complete exact-degree spherical-harmonic interpolation and singular-value classification for the canonical 24-cell answers precisely when any antipodally compatible data are attainable and with what spectral conditioning. The two-dimensional nonconstant degree-six defect and lost-then-restored degree-ten surjectivity are motivated by known exceptional 24-cell harmonic design behavior but not determined by its constant-mode theory.
